localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly, per night pet fee applies. Declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or at the park when you check in. Read and understand pet rules. Cabins 1 through 4 are 12-by-12 feet size and come with a small refrigerator with freezer, microwave, one double bed, and two single bunks. Outside each cabin, there is a fire ring and an upright pedestal grill. Restrooms are located nearby in the park. Cabin has heat and electricity.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
The group camp is a walk in/tent only group camp that accommodates up to 24 people. No recreational/camping vehicles allowed in the area. Campers with recreational/camping vehicles must reserve a campsite in the campground. Showers and restrooms are nearby.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
Maximum Van/Camper Length: 20 feet
Maximum Van/Camper Length: 20 feet

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The beach shelter capacity is 175 people. It provides a view of Padilla Bay, two large barbecues and ADA access, but no electricity. Rental fees vary depending on size of the group.
A Special Activity Permit is required for the following: Weddings and large events over 20 people, large items brought into the park, event rentals, vendors, food trucks, etc. Please contact the park in advance at (360) 387-1550 to obtain a permit.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
Site has 15, 20, 30, and 50 Amp electrical service.
